messages:
alex: seeing a sudden spike of 503s on hosted inference around 10:15 UTC, root cause looks like upstream inference worker crashes (SIGSEGV) on a subset of GPU nodes. Logs attached below.
cs_olivia: customers pinging support, two paying customers reported timeouts and one started a billing escalation. Impacted routes: /v1/generate (model: rwd-open-vicuna-13b-quant).
devops-bot: alert: hosted-api-prod - 503-rate > 8pct (10:14:30) -> task_id=alert-9812, nodes affected: infer-nodes-prod-{8,9,10}.
eng-oncall: @sre_jamie can you grab the core/dmesg from infer-nodes-prod-9? include nvml logs too. Any recent deploys or hot model swaps? :eyes:
sre_jamie: grabbing core. early glance shows: 
```
[pid 12345] signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code=1 addr=0x7ff...
Backtrace: attn_kernel.cu:0x4f3a
quant_runner.cpp:0x12b
infer_runner.cc:0x5d0
```
maria: we did a model hot-reload at 10:12 UTC to swap rwd-open-vicuna-13b -> rwd-open-vicuna-13b-quant (autoswap experiment). Swap completed on pool A (nodes 8-12). Correlation looks tight.
eng-oncall: ok that's strong signal. Can we repro on staging with the same quant build + long-prefix streaming/continuous-batching? if kernel asserts then we have repro.
sre_jamie: collecting heap/coredump to GCS: gs://redwood-debug/infer-prod/coredump-infer9-7953210000.tgz (private link). Also grabbing nvcrash.txt and pstack.
cs_olivia: customers asking ETA. We should mitigate first — fallback to non-quant variant or route away from pool A.
eng-oncall: routing change in progress — moving traffic off pool A to pool B, enabling canary fallback model (rwd-open-vicuna-13b-fp16). will apply policy change now.
devops-bot: routing update applied (route-policy-381): pool A traffic -> 0% (10:27:12).
maria: rolling back the hot-reload to previous stable (v2) on pool A and disabling autoswap experiment. rollback command: `infra model rollback --pool pool-A --model rwd-open-vicuna-13b --to v2`.
sre_jamie: after routing + rollback, error rate dropped: 503-rate now 0.9% (10:32). p95 latency improved.
eng-oncall: can we reproduce in a dedicated staging cluster? steps we think triggered it: 1) quant model load 2) concurrent prefetch requests during warmup + long context (10k tokens) 3) continuous batching enabled. Repro attempt: `ab -n 200 -c 8 -T 'application/json' -p payload.json https://staging-hosted/api/v1/generate`.
product_tom: customers hit includes a finserv customer; opening priority Slack thread with their AE. CS to send temporary credits? @billing_bot please prepare billing hold options.
billing_bot: prepared a temporary credit token template; awaiting CS approval.
eng-oncall: next steps (short): 1) preserve coredump + NV capture 2) reproduce in staging with exact quant artifact 3) bisect kernel/attn changes in quant runner 4) consider disabling concurrent prefetch during hot-reload as a mitigation.
sre_jamie: initial bisect hint: crash in `attn_compute_kernel` when sequence length > 4096 and KV cache resize occurs during a concurrent launch (race during kernel scheduling). Patch candidate: add mutex around cache resize or serialize hotload with draining inflight requests.
maria: for immediate safety we will: disable autoswap experiments, block quant rollout to pool-A and add rollout guard `--drain-before-swap`. Rolling these flags now.
cs_olivia: told affected customers we mitigated and we will follow up with timeline. They requested repro steps and logs — link to redwood support attachment with logs.
eng-oncall: marking incident for follow-up postmortem. assigning research owners: @maria (model rollout), @sre_jamie (kernel/race), @alex (observability). Please capture timeline + mitigation docs.
sre_jamie: saving notes to incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-7953. Will upload coredumps + perf traces.
cs_olivia: closing customer threads temporarily; will re-open if any regression. Thanks team :thumbsup:
product_tom: record: consider adding a gating check in the console UI for quant/model hot-swap when active streaming QPS > X.
eng-oncall: agreed — adding to backlog and will prioritize after root cause.
